name: Ringo
summary: Inside a cave on Fire Plume Ridge, Ringo lies overcome by heat. The goblin explorer climbed partway up Un'Goro Crater's active volcano before collapsing. His friend Spraggle Frock waits at Marshal's Refuge, worried for him.

sections.title: A Venture Too Close to the Flame
sections.body:
Goblins brave dangerous places for wealth or oddities, yet Fire Plume Ridge is harsh even for them. The active volcano rises in the center of Un'Goro Crater. It spews ash, magma, and boiling steam.

Ringo climbed about halfway up its southern face before the suffocating heat overcame him. He left his belongings scattered outside a cave, then crawled inside for shelter. Heat exhaustion left him unable to move.

sections.title: A Grueling Trek Down the Slopes
sections.body:
The journey down the mountain is an ordeal for Ringo. Dehydration and heatstroke leave him so weak that he faints again and again on the descent. Splashes from a canteen, or sometimes a brisk slap, wake him.

The route to Marshal's Refuge passes volatile elementals and predators. The escort must stay alert until Ringo can reunite with Spraggle.

faq.answer: Ringo is a goblin explorer in Un'Goro Crater. He climbed Fire Plume Ridge and collapsed from heat exhaustion inside a cave.
Ringo lies in a south-facing cave about halfway up Fire Plume Ridge, in the center of Un'Goro Crater.
Spraggle Frock, Ringo's good friend at Marshal's Refuge in northern Un'Goro, is deeply worried about his disappearance.

faq.q: Why keeps fainting on the way down?
faq.answer: Volcanic heat and fumes have left Ringo severely exhausted and dehydrated, so he keeps fainting. Spraggle's canteen is needed to wake him when he passes out.
Ringo's Sack is his personal pack. He left it just outside the cave when the heat overcame him and he retreated inside.

faq.q: Where does Ringo need to go?
faq.answer: Ringo needs an escort off the volcano and across the crater floor to Marshal's Refuge. His friend Spraggle Frock is waiting there.
